verdict.rationale: n8n supports code-level extensibility via custom JS/Python code nodes with npm packages, a documented CLI, and an n8n API for programmatic control, giving developers real levers to build custom logic and integrations. However, there's no dedicated SDK for building distributable custom nodes/connectors evidenced, and community feedback explicitly calls out that documentation 'leaves a lot to be desired, especially regarding custom node development,' directly undercutting the 'documented developer platform' claim for this specific use case. Missing for 10: a dedicated custom-node/connector SDK with first-party scaffolding tools, stronger official docs on building and publishing custom nodes, and independent hands-on confirmation that custom connector development is smooth.
